summary: BBC News reports on major global events including devastating Nepal-Tibet floods with nearly 2,000 missing, a US-Venezuela oil deal, Trump's renaming of Lake Ontario, and other top stories.

claims.text: The number of people missing after Nepal flash floods has jumped to nearly 2,000, including hundreds of foreign nationals.
claims.evidence_quote: Number of people missing after Nepal flash floods jumps significantly to nearly 2,000

claims.text: The US and Venezuela have reached a 'historic' oil deal granting the US majority control of over 65 billion barrels of proven Venezuelan oil reserves.
claims.evidence_quote: The agreement would grant the US majority control of over 65 billion barrels of proven Venezuelan oil reserves, Trump said.

claims.text: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America.
claims.evidence_quote: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order seeking to change the name of one of the Great Lakes to Lake America.

claims.text: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos has been detained by ICE.
claims.evidence_quote: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE

claims.text: A 97-year-old woman, Guna Maya Bohara, was rescued after Nepali floods using an excavator.
claims.evidence_quote: 97-year-old woman rescued after Nepali floods looked like 'a warrior'

claims.text: Tennessee governor plans to name Nashville airport after Dolly Parton.
claims.evidence_quote: Tennessee governor plans to name Nashville airport after Dolly Parton

claims.text: Canada is poaching dozens of top US researchers, with 48 researchers moving north due to new research funding from the Carney government.
claims.evidence_quote: 48 US researchers in fields like climate and medicine will soon be moving north.
